title: Antibiotic Resistance: It's Not Your Body
description:
Antibiotic resistance doesn't mean your body becomes resistant. Bacteria change so medicines stop working on them, and resistant bacteria can spread between people. Misuse and overuse speed this up; WHO calls AMR one of the top global public health threats.

Sources:
• WHO fact sheet: Antimicrobial resistance: https://www.who.int/news-room/fact-sheets/detail/antimicrobial-resistance
• CDC: About antimicrobial resistance: https://www.cdc.gov/antimicrobial-resistance/about/index.html

✅ Fact-checked as of 23 Nov 2026. Medical evidence and guidelines change; check the sources above for updates.
